$comment: Essential Eight → ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A control mappings. Derived from the ACSC mapping appendix to ISO/IEC 27002:2022 (which shares Annex A IDs with ISO 27001:2022) and Drata's published cross-walk. Each E8 maturity level inherits the lower level's mappings; we only encode the *new* relationships introduced at each level so the seed is idempotent and the related-controls UI doesn't double-count.
source: ACSC Essential Eight to ISO/IEC 27002:2022 mapping (Apr 2024) + Drata cross-framework table

mappings.rationale: Application control prevents unauthorised software execution — directly satisfies ISO A.8.7 protection against malware in user-profile/temp paths.
Allowlisting governs installation of software on operational systems.
Centralised logging of allowed/blocked execution events satisfies the logging control.
Log retention with tamper protection aligns with clock-synchronised, integrity-protected logs.
Monitoring + timely analysis of allowed/blocked execution maps to monitoring activities.
Vulnerability management of applications with vendor-aligned SLAs.
Extended scope of vulnerability management.
Annual penetration testing supports security testing in development and acceptance.
Published vulnerability disclosure policy aligns with threat intelligence sharing.
Disabling macros for users without business need is a malware mitigation.
Locked macro security settings constrain installed-software configuration.
Central logging of macro execution events is a logging control.
Monitoring of macro execution events is part of monitoring activities.
Browser hardening + locked settings is configuration management.
ASR + Office hardening + Constrained Language Mode are configuration baseline controls.
PowerShell script-block logging is logging.
Monitored PowerShell logs satisfies monitoring activities.
Validated requests + segregation of admin/standard accounts is privileged access management.
Access provisioning workflow.
Periodic revalidation, jump server, PAM-managed credentials are PAM controls.
Identity lifecycle (12-month revalidation, 45-day inactivity disable).
Centrally logged + retained privileged access events.
Just-in-time admin and Credential Guard support secure authentication.
Monitoring + analysis of privileged access for malicious activity.
Vulnerability management of operating systems and network devices with vendor-aligned SLAs.
Tightened patch SLA + supported OS versions.
Patching of drivers/firmware extends vulnerability management scope.
MFA on internet-facing services is a secure authentication control.
Phishing-resistant MFA for privileged users + central logging.
Central logging of MFA success/failure events.
Verifier impersonation-resistant MFA for important data accesses.
Monitoring + timely analysis of MFA events.
Backups aligned to BC requirements with restoration tests.
Restoration tested as part of DR exercises supports ICT readiness for business continuity.
Privileged accounts cannot tamper with backups during retention.
Immutable, segmented backups.
